# Depthwatch

> Depthwatch is an open-source liquidity observatory for Base mainnet (chain id 8453). Its read-only JSON API reports, for each tracked Uniswap v3, Uniswap v4, Aerodrome v2, Aerodrome Slipstream, Aero v2 and Aero Slipstream pool, the capital needed to move the price by 1, 2 and 5 % on each side, the round-trip cost of $1k / $10k / $100k / $1M trades with fees included, LP concentration, liquidity persistence over 24 h and 7 d, a 0–100 Liquidity Health Score (graded A–F only for pools with at least $5,000 on the thinner ±2 % side; the rest are marked unrated), and a feed of pools whose volume outruns their depth.

Links below are relative to this file. On a Depthwatch server they resolve to `/AGENTS.md`, `/openapi.json` and the `/api/...` routes. Call `GET /api/health` first: `source: "demo"` means synthetic data that must not be traded on. Tokens are identified by address: symbols repeat (Aerodrome's and Aero's AERO are both `AERO`), and every token object carries a display `label`. Slipstream pool fees can change every block. This API does not execute or route trades, and its USD prices are not an oracle.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): conventions and units, every GET route with parameters and response fields, curl examples, how to pick a pool for a trade, errors, caching
- [openapi.json](./openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 description of every GET route and its response schema
- [Metric definitions](https://github.com/0xdeni/depthwatch/blob/main/docs/METRICS.md): formulas, null semantics and worked examples for every number
- [Market-maker scorecards](https://github.com/0xdeni/depthwatch/blob/main/docs/SCORECARDS.md): mandates, attribution, uptime and badges

## API

- [Health](./api/health): database counts, newest snapshot and its age in seconds, newest score, data source (`demo` or `live`); `?maxAge=<seconds>` answers 503 when the newest snapshot is older or missing
- [Pools](./api/pools): scored pools with their ±2 % depth per side, ranked by health, depth, volume, gap score or TVL; filter by DEX, token or pool text, minimum volume and rated or unrated
- [Gaps](./api/gaps): pools with real 24 h volume on thin ±2 % depth, highest gap score first
- [Stats](./api/stats): pools, depth and volume totals per DEX
- [Scorecards](./api/mm): market-maker mandates with uptime against their depth and spread KPIs

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/0xdeni/depthwatch): MIT-licensed repository (pipeline, API, dashboard)
- [Base documentation index](https://docs.base.org/llms.txt): Base's own docs, the first source for Base network and integration questions
